title: 第025章 叶家没希望了不叶炎还活着第026章 现在废物都这么狂了吗
content_zh:
苍元山内，一处山林间，齐家的少年凝神！
“叶炎？”
“哈哈哈，仅有你一人？”
“先别将他杀死，我要让其跪下来，为我……”
齐家内，齐林等人开口。
咻！
只是还没等其话语落下，叶炎身影一动，魂力便随之释放而出，齐家众人的神色猛然一变，脑海都瞬间空白下来。
等他们反应过来的时刻，他们的头颅已与身体彻底分开。
“魂师，你竟是魂师？”齐林喃喃，但随后永久的闭上了双眼。
“齐家，除却齐山之外全都死了。”
“接下来，只剩下方家的一批人！”
叶炎喃喃。
如今他已是踏入到了这幻境中一个时辰，不过苍元山不大，凭借着魂力也使得叶炎可以快速的找到他们的所在。
咻！
此时，叶炎身影一动，直接落在树梢之上，犹如灵兽一般在这树梢之间行走。
而在此时，那苍云广场上，一道光芒闪烁。
“那是……齐山！”
“他竟是第一个走出！”
嗡！
下一刻，又是一道光芒出现。

“方不语？”
“齐家与方家的这两位，果然是天才！”
“这一届的苍云战乃是他们两人的争夺，其他人只能成为绿叶！”不少人唏嘘道。
不过就在下一瞬，又是一道身影出现。
嗯？
望着这一道身影，很多修炼者凝神。
“这人是谁？”
这少年脖颈处有着一个巴掌大的胎记，但却无人知晓。
“不是齐家、方家乃至吴家、赵家之人，显然也并非是叶家少年，其出身应该并不强大，没想到他竟是第三个走出。”很多人愕然。
不过这少年却神色凝聚，宠辱不惊。
望着这少年，花婆婆嘴角处浮现出一抹笑意。
这便是她的一张底牌！
若齐家办事不力，那这少年便可横扫一切。
这人，可比齐山还要强。
content_en:
In Cangyuan Mountain, in a forest, the young men of the Qi family are concentrating!
"Ye Yan?"
"Hahaha, you're the only one?"
"Don't kill him yet, I want him to kneel down and do it for me..."
In the Qi family, Qi Lin and others spoke.
call out!
But before he could finish his words, Ye Yan's figure moved, and his soul power was released. The expressions of everyone in the Qi family suddenly changed, and their minds instantly went blank.
By the time they reacted, their heads had been completely separated from their bodies.
"Soul Master, you are actually a soul master?" Qi Lin muttered, but then closed his eyes permanently.
"Everyone in the Qi family is dead except Qi Shan."
"Next, only a group of people from the Fang family will be left!"
Ye Yan murmured.
Now he has stepped into this illusion for an hour, but Cangyuan Mountain is not big, and Ye Yan can quickly find their location with his soul power.
call out!
At this time, Ye Yan's figure moved and landed directly on the treetops, walking among the treetops like a spiritual beast.
At this moment, a ray of light flashed on the Cangyun Square.
"That's... Qishan!"
"He was the first to walk out!"
Buzz!
The next moment, another ray of light appeared.
"Fang Buyu?"
"These two people from the Qi family and the Fang family are indeed geniuses!"
"This time's Cangyun Battle is between the two of them, and the others can only become green leaves!" Many people lamented.
But in the next moment, another figure appeared.
Um?
Looking at this figure, many cultivators concentrated.
"Who is this person?"
This young man has a palm-sized birthmark on his neck, but no one knows about it.
"He is not from the Qi family, the Fang family, or even the Wu family or the Zhao family. He is obviously not a young man from the Ye family. His background should not be strong. I didn't expect that he was the third one to leave." Many people were shocked.
However, this young man's expression was calm and unfazed.
Looking at the young man, a smile appeared on the corner of Granny Hua's mouth.
This is one of her trump cards!
If the Qi family doesn't do things well, then this young man can sweep everything away.
This man is even stronger than Qi Shan.
